Thumela inombolo kamazisi nge-SMS ku-32810 (R1 nge-SMS ngayinye), ushayele *120*432#, noma usebenzise My Registration Details ku-elections.org.za. Ungahlola imininingwane yakho yohlelo ngaphansi kokuthi Hlola ukubhalisa kwami ekhaya.

Cha. Amaphepha akho agcinwa ngethokheni yokuvota esetshenziswa kanye, hhayi igama lakho noma inombolo kamazisi. Amarisidi aqinisekisa ukuthi iphepha lirekhodiwe, hhayi iqembu olikhethile.

Igama lakho, inombolo kamazisi, izithombe zikamazisi, isifanekiso sobuso, ikheli nenombolo yeselula, kusetshenziswa kuphela ukukubhalisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe. Ngaphansi kwe-POPIA ungacela ukubona noma ukulungisa lolu lwazi ngokuthi Bika inkinga.
